title: Fix pre-existing ruff findings in backend test files
description: A full-repo `ruff check backend/` (not the narrower `ruff check app/` that static-verify/pr-reviewer/pr-decision have been running as their gated command all session) surfaces 7 pre-existing lint findings in test files, none introduced by any task worked this session -- they were repeatedly noticed and correctly judged out-of-scope by individual PR reviews (since none of those PRs touched these files), but never fixed or tracked as their own task, so they've kept resurfacing as noise in review after review. 6 are auto-fixable `I001` unsorted/unformatted import blocks (test_stooq_provider.py, test_autoenvelope.py, test_elder_ray.py, test_force_index.py, test_rsi.py, test_stochastic.py); 1 is a genuine `F841` unused local variable (`full_ohlcv` in test_triple_screen.py's `_weekly_ohlcv` truncation test, assigned but never read after a prior refactor). Also worth deciding: whether static-verify's own gated command (`ruff check app/`) should widen to include `tests/` too, so this class of drift gets caught going forward instead of only being noticed incidentally during PR reviews.

checklist.step: Run `ruff check backend/ --fix` to auto-fix the 6 unsorted-import findings; confirm no behavior change (tests still pass, coverage unaffected).

Fix the genuine F841 finding in test_triple_screen.py (either use `full_ohlcv` in an assertion it was clearly meant to support, or remove the now-dead assignment) -- read the surrounding test to determine which is correct, not just silence the warning.

Decide and record whether static-verify's gated ruff command should widen from `app/` to include `tests/`, so this class of drift is caught by the normal pipeline instead of only being noticed incidentally during PR reviews.
Confirm `ruff check backend/` (or backend/'s full test+app tree) is clean after the fix.

decisions.decision: Widen static-verify's gated backend lint command from `ruff check app/` to `ruff check .` (run from `backend/`, so it covers `app/` and `tests/` alike), rather than leaving it scoped to `app/` only.
decisions.rationale: Checked `backend/pyproject.toml`'s `[tool.ruff]` section: unlike `[tool.mypy]`, which deliberately scopes to `files = ["app"]` (test code isn't held to the same strict-typing bar, per that config's own rationale on docs/tasks/skill-static-verify.json), `[tool.ruff]` has no such scoping -- it only excludes `app/db/migrations/versions`, so it was always intended to apply repo-wide. The narrower `ruff check app/` gate used by static-verify/pr-reviewer/pr-decision meant real, auto-fixable lint findings in `tests/` (5 I001 unsorted-import blocks, 1 UP012 unnecessary-encode, repeatedly noticed but correctly judged out-of-scope by individual PR reviews) kept resurfacing as incidental review noise across many PRs instead of being caught by the normal static-verify gate. Considered and rejected leaving the gate as `app/`-only and only fixing the pre-existing findings by hand (this task's original scope): that fixes the symptom once but leaves the same drift class free to recur on the next test file that adds an unsorted import, with nothing in the pipeline to catch it before another PR review notices it again. `ruff check .` from `backend/` is confirmed clean after this task's fixes, so widening imposes no new false-positive burden today.

decisions.decision: Correction to this task's own description text: the description says '6 are auto-fixable I001 unsorted/unformatted import blocks (test_stooq_provider.py, test_autoenvelope.py, test_elder_ray.py, test_force_index.py, test_rsi.py, test_stochastic.py)' -- that is wrong about test_stooq_provider.py specifically. Re-verified directly with `ruff check` against that file's pre-fix (main-branch) content: its only pre-existing finding was UP012 (unnecessary `.encode("utf-8")`), not I001. The actual I001 set is the other five files listed (test_autoenvelope.py, test_elder_ray.py, test_force_index.py, test_rsi.py, test_stochastic.py); test_stooq_provider.py's fix was the UP012 one. The total finding count (6 auto-fixable + 1 F841 = 7) and every code fix applied by this task remain correct -- this is a wording-only correction to the description text, not a functional or code change. Recorded as a fresh append-only entry per CLAUDE.md's decision-memory correction convention rather than editing the original description text in place, since this task's checklist did not itself call out the description text as the thing to fix.
decisions.rationale: This wording slip (inherited from PR #277's own description and repeated in PR #278's description/commit message without correction) was flagged as a non-blocking finding in this task's own `review.comments` and tracked as a checklist item on backend-static-verify-cleanup-followups. That followup task's checklist item explicitly says: 'If revisited: correct the task's own description/checklist text via a fresh note ... rather than editing it in place, and correct PR #278's description via an additive PR comment ... rather than editing the merged PR body in place.' This entry is that fresh note; PR #278 received a corresponding additive comment rather than an in-place body edit for the same reason -- both preserve the original (mistaken) text's git/PR history rather than silently overwriting it.

comments.summary: Verified each of the 6 auto-fixed findings against ruff run on the pre-fix (main-branch) file content: 5 genuine I001 import-block reorder/blank-line fixes (test_autoenvelope.py, test_elder_ray.py, test_force_index.py, test_rsi.py, test_stochastic.py) and 1 genuine UP012 encode->bytes-literal fix (test_stooq_provider.py, byte-identical since the string is pure ASCII) -- all behavior-neutral.

F841 fix in test_triple_screen.py confirmed correct: read the whole TestEvaluateTidePrecomputedSeries.test_precomputed_series_causal_slice_matches_recomputing_on_truncated_series test -- full_ohlcv was dead (full_components/full_ema_13 are computed straight from `closes`, and only truncated_ohlcv is used downstream), so deletion (not adding an assertion) was the right call.

static-verify scope-widening decision (ruff check app/ -> ruff check .) checked against backend/pyproject.toml: [tool.ruff] has no files= scoping (only excludes app/db/migrations/versions), unlike [tool.mypy]'s deliberate files=["app"]. Re-ran `ruff check .` from backend/ myself independently -- clean. Decision and rationale are sound.

Independently re-ran the full backend suite with coverage: 1194 passed, 100% line/branch coverage, matching the PR's reported numbers exactly. mypy (scoped correctly per static-verify's `mypy` command, not `mypy .`) and ruff check . both clean; python3 scripts/validate_tasks.py clean (280 files, no violations).

Non-blocking: PR #278's description/commit message (and the task's own pre-existing description/checklist text, carried over from PR #277) say '5/6 I001 unsorted-import findings' while listing test_stooq_provider.py among the I001 files -- that file's only actual pre-existing finding was UP012, not I001 (verified directly with ruff against main-branch content). Total finding count (7) and every actual code fix are correct; this is a wording slip only. Tracked as a checklist item on backend-static-verify-cleanup-followups rather than fixed in this review pass.

review.notes: No blocking findings. Checklist scoped to backend area (no frontend/, no API route or schema change, no new module/dependency/layer) -- static-verify's own SKILL.md was the only non-test file touched, and it was reviewed for both wording accuracy and re-verified functionally. No UI-facing surface in this PR (test-file lint fixes and an internal skill-doc change only) -- browser walkthrough (step 9) and the persisted e2e suite (step 9a) are explicitly skipped as not applicable. Checklist item 3 ('decide whether to widen ruff scope') has a corresponding decisions entry with rationale, satisfying the decide-X cross-check. code-review skill (medium effort) run in parallel corroborated the same findings independently, including the same I001/UP012 wording-slip observation recorded above.

pr_decision.notes: Independently re-ran `ruff check .` and `mypy` (both clean) and the full backend suite (`pytest --cov=app --cov-report=term-missing`): 1194 passed, 100% line/branch coverage -- matches pr-reviewer's reported numbers exactly. `python3 scripts/validate_tasks.py` clean (281 files). Skimmed the full diff: all 6 auto-fix hunks (5 I001 reorders + 1 UP012 bytes-literal rewrite) and the F841 deletion in test_triple_screen.py are behavior-neutral, confirmed the deleted `full_ohlcv` var was genuinely dead by reading the surrounding test. Independently re-verified the flagged non-blocking wording slip: checked test_stooq_provider.py's pre-fix content in place (git show origin/main:... written back into the file so ruff's config discovery applies) with `ruff check --select I001,UP012` -- confirms it had only UP012, no I001, so the PR description/task text listing it among the 5 I001 files is a wording-only slip, already tracked non-blocking on backend-static-verify-cleanup-followups. Task-board bookkeeping (done/ move, decisions entry, review block, index.json mirror, followups task) all correct. Accept holds.
